where.heading: Where it works, and with which model
where.footer: An Agent stays on one Machine. The Runtime makes its Workdir at ~/.veeloe/agents/<id>/workdir (ADR 0002, 0032, 0042, 0043).

provider.label: Provider and model
provider.footer: The models come from the Providers set on this Machine. Someone with Manage can change them later, from the next Task on (ADR 0042).

allowlist.heading: Commands that run right away
allowlist.footer: There is no find, sed, or git and npm on their own, since they can change or delete files. Untick what you don't want before creating (ADR 0030).
